picks.editorial_note: A $334 million Schmidt Sciences grant to NCSA is one of the largest single investments in academic scientific computing this year, dramatically expanding national AI-research infrastructure.
picks.title: NCSA Joins the Schmidt Science Computing Network to Expand Advanced Computing for Scientific Discovery

picks.editorial_note: UC Berkeley and Berkeley Lab's entry into the Schmidt Science Computing Network, anchored by a major grant establishing the Berkeley Science AI Platform at NERSC, signals a coordinated multi-institution push to build out AI-ready HPC capacity for science.
picks.title: UC Berkeley, Berkeley Lab collaboration with Schmidt Science Computing Network will Provide High Performance Computing for Cutting-Edge Research - NERSC: National Energy Research Scientific Computing Center

picks.editorial_note: A £39 million UKRI investment funding 20 Turing AI Fellows is a substantial national commitment to building UK AI research capacity across fields from turbulence modeling to human-AI interaction.
picks.title: Turing AI Fellows set to strengthen UK’s AI capability | News | The University of Edinburgh

picks.editorial_note: Fermilab's multi-laboratory FemtoMind project applying agentic AI to lattice QCD calculations under the Genesis Mission represents a genuine scientific push to accelerate fundamental particle-physics research with AI.
picks.title: FemtoMind advances Genesis Mission at the proton scale

picks.editorial_note: HKUST's new Center for Marine Intelligence and its AI4Coral partnership with KAUST pairs AI and robotics for automated coral reef monitoring, an internationally coordinated application of AI to environmental science.
picks.title: HKUST Establishes Center for Marine Intelligence and Partners with KAUST to Launch Inaugural AI4Coral Research Project
picks.university: Hong Kong Univ. of Science and Technology

picks.editorial_note: The acquisition of Imperial College London spinout Cogitat by Swiss neurotech firm Indivi for its brain-decoding foundation model shows real commercial validation of academic AI research translating into industry impact.
picks.title: Imperial spinout Cogitat acquired by Swiss startup Indivi for its brain foundation model

picks.editorial_note: A Cambridge-led analysis finding a third of the global AI supply chain is invisible to government oversight highlights a major governance and policy blind spot with direct implications for AI regulation and national security.
picks.title: A third of the global AI supply chain is ‘invisible’ to governments

picks.editorial_note: A systematic review by MIT CSAIL and 17 other institutions cataloging 95 scenarios for how advanced AI could cause catastrophic harm is a significant contribution to the AI safety and governance discourse.
picks.title: Researchers find eight ways AI could lead to our downfall

picks.editorial_note: Michigan Tech and UCLA researchers showing AI models need far less training data than assumed to predict materials' electronic structures could meaningfully accelerate materials discovery pipelines.
picks.title: Less Data, Faster Discovery: Researchers Rethink AI’s Role in Developing New Materials

picks.editorial_note: The completion of DARPA's Triage Challenge Finals, testing autonomous systems in simulated disaster triage, marks a concrete milestone for real-world deployment of AI-driven search-and-rescue technology.
picks.title: DARPA Triage Challenge completes Finals event
